title: Vid2Reel cut list
description: Version 1 of the cut list: the one place where every edit decision lives. The chat's Claude writes it and render builds exactly what it says. Every time in it is in seconds on a clip's working copy. This file holds structure only; the numbers that control behaviour (the two canvas sizes, the frame rate, the touch-up limits, the shortest reel) live in v2r/settings.py and are checked by `v2r check`, not here. No object is closed to extra fields: an unknown field is reported by check as a note, not as a problem.

version.description: The layout of the list. This is version 1; a later layout gets a new number and old lists must still render.

canvas.description: The size and frame rate of the finished reel. check compares it with the allowed shapes and with the clips in the work folder.

clips.description: One record per clip, keyed by the clip's capital letter, copied from the work folder's manifest. The key is checked as a whole by check as well as by this pattern, because the pattern's end-of-text sign also matches before a final line break.

segments.description: The shots, in the order they play. Segment numbers count from 1.

look.description: The mild touch-up that makes the clips look like one shoot, and the filter choice.

filter.description: A named colour look. Only none can be built until Stage 21.

touch_up.description: One record per clip letter. The limits on each number are in v2r/settings.py and are checked by check.

music.description: A track id from music/library.json, test-tone, or null for no music.

music_from.description: Seconds into the track where the music starts.

fade_in.description: Seconds the music takes to rise at the start.

fade_out.description: Seconds the music takes to fall at the end.

music_under_sound.description: Decibels the music drops by while a shot's own sound plays. Zero or below.

loudness.description: The reel's target loudness in LUFS. Zero or below.

cover.description: The still picked as the reel's cover.

segment.description: Which segment, counting from 1 in list order.

text.description: Words on screen. Accepted, not built yet (Stage 21).

voice.description: A voice track. Accepted, not built yet (Stage 25).

clip.description: One clip, as the work folder's manifest records it.

file.description: The original's file name, as the manifest records it.

seconds.description: The length of the working copy in seconds.

segment.description: One shot: a stretch of one clip.

clip.description: The clip's capital letter. check also tests the letter as a whole, as the pattern's end-of-text sign matches before a final line break.

from.description: Seconds into the working copy where the shot starts.

to.description: Seconds into the working copy where the shot ends.

focus_x.description: Where across the picture the subject is, 0 left to 1 right. The middle (0.5) when left out.

focus_y.description: Where down the picture the subject is, 0 top to 1 bottom. The middle (0.5) when left out.

move.description: A gentle movement over the shot. None when left out.

sound.description: Whether the shot's own sound is kept. Required, so a reel's sound is never an accident.

why.description: One sentence saying why this stretch, citing the still labels it rests on, such as B 07.5.

touch_up.description: The touch-up for one clip. Brightness, blue and red are offsets in 8-bit code values; saturation is a multiplier, 1 meaning unchanged.
